card.name: Repeated digits inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 5, 6 or 7 when it is the second digit of a number, as in 66, 55, 550, or 77°F. It also fires on the 6 in CYP2D6 and M61.

modes.label: Doubled digit in numbers
modes.description: A digit that repeats the one before it inside a figure such as a percentage, dose or temperature.

modes.label: The 6 in names
modes.description: The final 6 in enzyme or model names such as CYP2D6.

card.plain: It fires on a repeated digit, such as the second 6 in 66, and on the 6 in CYP2D6.
